purpose: Per-finding applicability and remediation evidence for all 68 original Debian advisories. This is not a scanner ignore policy, vulnerability-free certification, or automatic acceptance of unresolved risks.
method: Read every CVE record directly from Debian Security Tracker and cross-check stable/unstable status against its official JSON export.
Inspect affected functionality and component presence in the actual baseline image.
Retain conditional or unresolved live-library findings; no low-severity blanket dismissal.
Parent independently authenticated exact zlib source and installed arm64 binary; classification remains provisional while Debian still reports vulnerable.

findings.affected_functionality: Path-based libacl ACL operations follow attacker-replaced symlinks.
findings.assessment: libacl1 is installed; Sandloom has no identified ACL call site. Nonroot limits privileges, but library presence alone cannot establish non-applicability for arbitrary application code.
findings.recommended_remediation: Remove unused libacl only if package dependencies permit; otherwise enforce no-new-privileges, no capabilities and a read-only root filesystem, then install a supported stable ACL update when available.

findings.affected_functionality: Restricted SUID bind mounts can race path resolution and redirect ownership/mode changes.
findings.assessment: The baseline has SUID mount. Application services should never need privileged fstab bind mounts.
findings.recommended_remediation: Remove mount or its privilege bit and enforce no-new-privileges/capability drops; a stable package update remains the actual library/tool fix.

findings.affected_functionality: Readline-enabled util-linux chfn/chsh can disclose privileged files through INPUTRC errors.
findings.assessment: Debian builds util-linux with --disable-chfn-chsh; the installed chfn/chsh are supplied by src:shadow. Debian explicitly documents this source/binary mismatch.
findings.recommended_remediation: Verify ownership/build configuration when the base changes; removing account-management utilities further reduces surface, but do not claim all similarly named tools share this CVE.

findings.affected_functionality: zlib CRC-combine generation can loop on invalid length arguments.
findings.assessment: The native zlib library is installed. Python 3.12 has no crc32_combine binding; other native callers cannot be universally excluded.
findings.recommended_remediation: Avoid negative/unbounded lengths in any native combine caller and await a supported stable zlib update; do not remove compression required by Python.

findings.affected_functionality: New non-blocking gzwrite/gzprintf retry logic can retain a stale buffer after a write stall.
findings.assessment: Authenticated Debian 1.3.1 source lacks gz_vacate and state->again; write errors are fatal before the subsequent memmove. The installed arm64 library matches the authenticated Debian artifact. Debian still marks trixie vulnerable.
findings.recommended_remediation: Preserve exact source/binary hashes and vendor-reference evidence, keep the finding provisional, and seek Debian/Snyk classification correction or install an eventual supported stable update.
